info.title: MICROSERVICE_DEV_Appointment Management API
info.description: The Appointment Scheduling API facilitates the creation and management of patient appointments within healthcare systems. This endpoint allows healthcare providers to register new appointments for patients, ensuring organized and streamlined scheduling. Typical consumers include medical staff and administrative personnel who need efficient tools to manage schedules. The API supports critical functionalities that enhance patient care by optimizing appointment availability and improving workflow.

post.description: This operation allows you to schedule a new appointment by providing the necessary details. Ensure all required fields are filled to successfully create an appointment.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new appointment. It should include all necessary details for the appointment including date, time, participant information, and any relevant notes.

400.description: The request parameters provided are invalid.
